PZZ700-152215-
109 AM PST Sun Nov 15 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...At 1 PM, a 959 mb low 
was 500 nautical miles northwest of Cape Flattery, WA and a 1018 
mb high located over the Four Corners. Winds and seas have largely
diminished this morning, and will remain sub-hazardous until
Monday. Winds and seas ramp back up Monday afternoon with 25-30 kt
gusts expected, with steep, high seas of 8-11 feet. These
conditions will persist into early Wednesday morning with
improving conditions by Wednesday afternoon. Conditions look to
deteriorate once again come Thursday afternoon as the next storm
system approaches.

$$

PZZ740-152215-
Coastal Waters from San Mateo Point to the Mexican Border and out
to 10 nm-
109 AM PST Sun Nov 15 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM MONDAY AFTERNOON THROUGH
LATE TUESDAY NIGHT...

.TODAY...Wind SE 10 kt...becoming SW this afternoon. Seas 4 to
6 ft. Wave Detail: E 1 foot at 4 seconds, W 4 ft at 16 seconds
and S 2 ft at 17 seconds. 
.TONIGHT...Wind variable less than 10 kt...becoming E 10 kt after
midnight. Seas 3 to 4 ft. Wave Detail: E 1 foot at 4 seconds, W
3 ft at 15 seconds and S 2 ft at 15 seconds. 
.MON...Wind SE 10 kt...becoming SW with gusts to 20 kt in the
afternoon. Seas 3 to 5 ft. Wave Detail: SE 1 foot at 4 seconds, S
2 ft at 15 seconds and W 4 ft at 18 seconds. A slight chance of
showers in the morning, then a chance of showers in the
afternoon. 
.MON NIGHT...Wind W 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt. Seas 4 to
6 ft...building to 7 to 9 ft after midnight. W 8 ft at 7 seconds
and S 2 ft at 14 seconds. Showers likely with a slight chance of
tstms in the evening, then showers likely after midnight. 
.TUE...Wind W 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt. Seas 8 to 10 ft.
Wave Detail: W 9 ft at 8 seconds and S 2 ft at 14 seconds. A
slight chance of showers in the morning. 
.TUE NIGHT...Wind NW 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt...becoming
10 to 15 kt after midnight. Seas 7 to 9 ft...subsiding to 6 to
7 ft after midnight. Wave Detail: NW 3 ft at 5 seconds, W 7 ft at
8 seconds and S 2 ft at 14 seconds...subsiding to NW 2 ft at
4 seconds, W 6 ft at 7 seconds and S 1 foot at 13 seconds. 
.WED...Wind NE 10 kt in the morning...becoming variable less than
10 kt. Seas 3 to 5 ft. Wave Detail: N 1 foot at 4 seconds, W 4 ft
at 7 seconds and S 1 foot at 13 seconds. 
.WED NIGHT...Wind NW 10 kt in the evening... becoming variable
less than 10 kt. Seas 3 ft. Wave Detail: W 1 foot at 4 seconds, W
2 ft at 12 seconds and S 1 foot at 13 seconds. A slight chance of
showers after midnight. 
.THU...Wind S 10 to 15 kt...becoming SW 15 to 20 kt in the
afternoon. Seas 4 to 6 ft...building to 7 to 8 ft in the
afternoon. SW 7 ft at 6 seconds and S 1 foot at 15 seconds. A
chance of showers in the morning, then showers likely with a
slight chance of tstms in the afternoon. 
.THU NIGHT...Wind W 20 to 25 kt...becoming 15 to 20 kt after
midnight. Seas 8 to 9 ft. Wave Detail: W 8 ft at 7 seconds and S
1 foot at 15 seconds. Showers.  

Winds and seas higher in and near tstms.

$$
